citations.narrative:
The current records of animals on hand are not correct.
* An armadillo at the facility is not listed and there are no acquisition forms showing when and where the animal originated
from.
* One llama on records does not have the information stating where it came from, when it arrived and sex of the animal.
* One Alpaca is notated on records but is no longer at the facility and there is no date or records of disposition.
The records of animals at the facility need to be maintained in a timely and accurate manner for record keeping purposes
and to show movement of animals. Every exhibitor shall make, keep, and maintain records or forms which fully and
correctly disclose the following information concerning animals purchased or otherwise acquired, owned, held, leased, or
otherwise in his or her possession or under his or her control, or which is transported, sold, euthanized, or otherwise
disposed of by that dealer or exhibitor.

The facility does not have shelter for the cow, zebu, goats and llama's at the facility. Per the licensee a new barn was to
be delivered the day of the inspection but had not arrived by the end of the inspection process. Not having access to a
shelter with colder fall temperatures occurring overnight could be distressful for the animals and animals should always
have the choice to seek shelter if needed.
Shelter from inclement weather conditions for the species concerned shall be provided for all animals kept outdoors to
afford them protection and to prevent discomfort to such animals.
This is a 1st Re-License Inspection for a Class “C” license. The inspection and exit briefing were conducted with the
applicant.
All items must be in compliance within (2) more inspection(s) or by Dec 14, 2026 or the applicant will forfeit the license fee
and must wait 6 months to reapply. Please contact your inspector to schedule your next Re-License Inspection.
You may appeal this finding in writing by (insert date which is 7 days after issuance of report).
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
Regulated activity can continue under your existing USDA license until it expires.
